_meta.purpose: Evidence registry — every source logged once, referenced by id from card.src[].
_meta.status: Backfilled: every card links to a fetch-verified, openable source URL with a concrete strength note.

schema.strength: describes how THICK the evidence is, concretely (e.g. 'two RCTs, n≈12k'; 'single case study') — never a bare 'strong'/'weak'
schema.kind: book | paper | dataset | report | reference | news

ev-date-constantinople-1453.title: Fall of Constantinople
ev-date-constantinople-1453.strength: Encyclopaedic account citing contemporary chronicles; date and outcome firmly attested.

ev-date-french-revolution-1789.title: Storming of the Bastille
ev-date-french-revolution-1789.strength: Encyclopaedic account of a precisely dated, well-documented event.

ev-date-moon-landing-1969.title: Apollo 11
ev-date-moon-landing-1969.strength: NASA's official mission record — a primary source.

ev-date-hijra-622.title: Hijrah
ev-date-hijra-622.strength: Encyclopaedic account; the year anchors the Islamic calendar, the exact day is reconstructed.

ev-date-prc-1949.title: Proclamation of the People's Republic of China
ev-date-prc-1949.strength: Encyclopaedic account of a precisely dated modern event.

ev-date-berlin-wall-1989.title: Berlin Wall
ev-date-berlin-wall-1989.strength: Encyclopaedic account; the 9 Nov 1989 opening is extensively documented.

ev-hist-printing.title: Printing press
ev-hist-printing.strength: Encyclopaedic synthesis; Gutenberg's ~1440 movable type is well established.

ev-hist-blackdeath.title: Black Death
ev-hist-blackdeath.strength: Encyclopaedic synthesis of historical records and recent DNA work; mortality estimates vary (a third or more).

ev-hist-westphalia.title: Peace of Westphalia
ev-hist-westphalia.strength: Encyclopaedic account; the 'birth of sovereignty' framing is common but debated by historians.

ev-phys-entropy.title: Second law of thermodynamics
ev-phys-entropy.strength: Established physical law; entropy increase in isolated systems is among the most robustly confirmed principles in physics.

ev-phys-uncertainty.title: Uncertainty principle
ev-phys-uncertainty.strength: Core quantum-mechanics result, repeatedly confirmed experimentally.

ev-phys-cmb.title: Cosmic microwave background
ev-phys-cmb.strength: Measured at 2.725 K by COBE/WMAP/Planck; among the strongest evidence for the Big Bang.

ev-bio-natural-selection.title: Natural selection
ev-bio-natural-selection.strength: Foundational, overwhelmingly evidenced theory of biology.

ev-bio-microbiome.title: Revised Estimates for the Number of Human and Bacteria Cells in the Body
ev-bio-microbiome.strength: Peer-reviewed estimate (PLOS Biology); ~1.3:1 bacteria:human with stated uncertainty, revising the old 10:1.

ev-eco-yellowstone.title: History of wolves in Yellowstone
ev-eco-yellowstone.strength: Reintroduction is well documented; the full trophic-cascade-to-rivers claim is debated among ecologists.

ev-eco-planetary-boundaries.title: Planetary Boundaries
ev-eco-planetary-boundaries.strength: Framework from the originating research centre; the 2023 assessment finds seven of nine boundaries transgressed.

ev-eco-haber-bosch.title: Haber process
ev-eco-haber-bosch.strength: Well-established industrial chemistry; the 'feeds about half the world' figure is a widely-cited estimate.

ev-sys-feedback.title: Feedback
ev-sys-feedback.strength: Standard systems concept: reinforcing vs balancing loops.

ev-sys-commons.title: Tragedy of the commons
ev-sys-commons.strength: Hardin's model plus Ostrom's Nobel-winning empirical rebuttal — both well documented.

ev-sys-powerlaw.title: Power law
ev-sys-powerlaw.strength: Well-established pattern (Pareto/Zipf); whether a given dataset is truly power-law is often debated case by case.

ev-eh-industrial-revolution.title: Economic Growth
ev-eh-industrial-revolution.strength: Data-rich synthesis (Maddison-based series); the post-1800 takeoff in GDP per capita is well documented.

ev-eh-enclosure.title: Enclosure
ev-eh-enclosure.strength: Encyclopaedic account; the enclosure-to-wage-labour link is well attested, though its weight is debated (Marxist vs other readings).

ev-eh-bretton-woods.title: Bretton Woods system
ev-eh-bretton-woods.strength: Well-documented monetary history; the 1971 'Nixon shock' is firmly dated.

ev-eh-great-depression.title: Great Depression
ev-eh-great-depression.strength: Extensively documented; its causes are still debated among economists.

ev-eh-neoliberal-turn.title: Neoliberalism
ev-eh-neoliberal-turn.strength: Well-documented Reagan/Thatcher-era policy shift; 'neoliberalism' as a label is itself contested.

ev-fun-octopus-hearts.title: Octopus
ev-fun-octopus-hearts.strength: Encyclopaedic; three hearts and copper-based haemocyanin (blue blood) are established zoology.

ev-fun-venus-day.title: Venus: Facts
ev-fun-venus-day.strength: NASA reference: 243-Earth-day rotation vs a 225-day orbit — a measured fact.

ev-fun-1816-no-summer.title: Year Without a Summer
ev-fun-1816-no-summer.strength: Well documented: coldest European summer on record 1766–2000, linked to the 1815 Tambora eruption.

ev-fun-honey-keeps.title: The Science Behind Honey's Eternal Shelf Life
ev-fun-honey-keeps.strength: Popular-science explainer quoting a honey scientist; the mechanism (low moisture, acidity, peroxide) is well established.

ev-date-sykes-picot-1916.title: Sykes–Picot Agreement
ev-date-sykes-picot-1916.strength: Encyclopaedic account citing the released text; the secret 1916 partition is firmly documented.

ev-date-year-of-africa-1960.title: Year of Africa
ev-date-year-of-africa-1960.strength: Encyclopaedic account; the 17 independences of 1960 are well documented.

ev-geo-thucydides.title: Thucydides Trap
ev-geo-thucydides.strength: Allison's framework; widely discussed but heavily criticised — the '12 of 16 cases led to war' claim is contested.

ev-geo-hormuz.title: Strait of Hormuz
ev-geo-hormuz.strength: Figure (~20–25% of seaborne oil) corroborated by EIA data; widely cited.

ev-geo-heartland.title: The Geographical Pivot of History
ev-geo-heartland.strength: Mackinder's original 1904 thesis — a historically influential doctrine, not an empirical law.

ev-geo-demographic.title: Demographic transition
ev-geo-demographic.strength: Well-established empirical pattern across developed countries; the stage details are debated.

ev-poli-median-voter.title: Median voter theorem
ev-poli-median-voter.strength: Formal result (Black, 1948); empirically limited — real parties don't fully converge to the centre.

ev-poli-duverger.title: Duverger's law
ev-poli-duverger.strength: Robust empirical tendency rather than an absolute rule (regional-party exceptions).

ev-poli-collective-action.title: Collective action problem
ev-poli-collective-action.strength: Well-established (Olson); explains free-riding, low turnout and under-provided public goods.

ev-game-prisoners-dilemma.title: Prisoner's Dilemma
ev-game-prisoners-dilemma.strength: Peer-reviewed SEP entry; canonical, formally analysed result.

ev-game-nash-equilibrium.title: Nash equilibrium
ev-game-nash-equilibrium.strength: Foundational game-theory concept; existence proven for finite games (Nash, 1950).

ev-game-repeated.title: Repeated game
ev-game-repeated.strength: Standard game theory; the folk theorem and Axelrod's tit-for-tat are well established.

ev-econ-comparative-advantage.title: Comparative advantage
ev-econ-comparative-advantage.strength: Ricardo's 1817 result; a core, widely-taught principle (with known real-world qualifications).

ev-econ-loss-aversion.title: Loss aversion
ev-econ-loss-aversion.strength: Prospect-theory finding, widely replicated — but the universal ~2:1 ratio is now debated.

ev-econ-what-is.title: Scarcity
ev-econ-what-is.strength: Robbins's standard definition of economics via scarce means and competing ends.

ev-econ-supply-demand.title: Supply and demand
ev-econ-supply-demand.strength: Foundational model; a deliberate simplification, not a literal account of all price-setting.

ev-econ-gdp.title: Gross domestic product
ev-econ-gdp.strength: Standard national-accounts measure; its omissions are well documented (Kuznets's own 1937 caveat).

ev-pe-what-is.title: Political economy
ev-pe-what-is.strength: Encyclopaedic overview of the field's politics-and-economics scope.

ev-pe-schools.title: Schools of economic thought
ev-pe-schools.strength: Encyclopaedic survey of rival schools — grounds the card's pluralism.

ev-pe-smith-wealth.title: The Wealth of Nations
ev-pe-smith-wealth.strength: Smith's 1776 work; the invisible-hand/self-interest reading is standard (and often oversimplified).

ev-pe-division-labour.title: Division of labour
ev-pe-division-labour.strength: Smith's pin-factory example; foundational and well documented.

ev-pe-ricardo.title: David Ricardo
ev-pe-ricardo.strength: Biography and works of the classical economist.

ev-pe-ltv.title: Labor theory of value
ev-pe-ltv.strength: Classical/Marxian theory, displaced by marginalism; its validity remains contested.

ev-pe-marginalist.title: Marginalism
ev-pe-marginalist.strength: The 1870s marginal revolution (Jevons, Menger, Walras); well documented.

ev-pe-marx-capital.title: Das Kapital
ev-pe-marx-capital.strength: Marx's Capital; influential and heavily contested.

ev-pe-historical-materialism.title: Historical materialism
ev-pe-historical-materialism.strength: Marx/Engels framework; influential in sociology, criticised for economic determinism.

ev-pe-keynes.title: The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money
ev-pe-keynes.strength: Keynes's 1936 work; the demand-deficient-slump argument is standard macro.

ev-pe-paradox-thrift.title: Paradox of thrift
ev-pe-paradox-thrift.strength: A fallacy-of-composition result; standard Keynesian point, disputed by some schools.

ev-pe-friedman.title: Monetarism
ev-pe-friedman.strength: Friedman's monetarism; influential, though the money-inflation link proved unstable after the 1980s.

ev-pe-hayek.title: The Use of Knowledge in Society
ev-pe-hayek.strength: Hayek's 1945 essay — the canonical statement of the knowledge problem.

ev-cs-halting.title: Halting problem
ev-cs-halting.strength: Turing's 1936 undecidability result — a proven theorem.

ev-stat-lln.title: Law of large numbers
ev-stat-lln.strength: Proven probability theorem; the gambler's-fallacy corollary is standard.

ev-stat-clt.title: Central limit theorem
ev-stat-clt.strength: Proven theorem under stated conditions (independence, finite variance).

ev-code-naming.title: TwoHardThings
ev-code-naming.strength: Fowler's note on the well-known 'naming things' adage (Karlton) — craft consensus, not an empirical claim.

ev-code-dry.title: Don't repeat yourself
ev-code-dry.strength: DRY principle from The Pragmatic Programmer; a widely-held craft principle.

ev-code-complexity.title: Is High Quality Software Worth the Cost?
ev-code-complexity.strength: Fowler's argument that internal quality lowers cost-of-change; reasoned craft view with some empirical support (DORA).

ev-math-godel.title: Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems
ev-math-godel.strength: Peer-reviewed SEP entry on the proven 1931 theorems.

ev-math-base-rate.title: Base rate fallacy
ev-math-base-rate.strength: Standard probability result; worked rare-disease example.

ev-philo-falsifiability.title: Falsifiability
ev-philo-falsifiability.strength: Popper's demarcation criterion; influential but contested (Kuhn, Lakatos).

ev-philo-is-ought.title: Is–ought problem
ev-philo-is-ought.strength: Hume's classic problem; widely accepted, with naturalist counter-arguments.

ev-philo-veil.title: Original position (veil of ignorance)
ev-philo-veil.strength: Rawls's thought experiment; influential, criticised by Nozick, Sandel and empirical work.

ev-logic-modus-ponens.title: Modus ponens
ev-logic-modus-ponens.strength: Standard valid inference rule (with modus tollens).

ev-china-reform-opening.title: China Overview
ev-china-reform-opening.strength: World Bank country data; the 'almost 800 million out of extreme poverty since 1978' figure is its official estimate.

ev-china-party-state.title: Chinese Communist Party
ev-china-party-state.strength: Encyclopaedic; the Party's supremacy over the state, army and courts is well documented.

ev-china-century-humiliation.title: Century of humiliation
ev-china-century-humiliation.strength: Encyclopaedic; the period is well documented and the narrative's political use by the CCP is noted.
